The 4-class attribution attains macro F1 86.4% (C0 91.2, C1 87.5, C2 84.1, C3 82.8), and the per-component ablation (Table IIa) confirms that spectral, probing, and provenance signals each contribute independently.

SELFCHECKGPT costs 1,840 ms/turn (five auxiliary LLM completions) and FACTSCORE 840.2 ms; RECONTRACE runs in 64.2 ms (4.8 probing + 4.9 claim extraction + 42.1 pairwise NLI + 12.3 Laplacian + 0.1 logistic) with zero extra LLM calls. With |V| = k + 3 + J bounded per turn, total cost is O(1) in the horizon T.

Scalability. O(1) also holds with respect to total memory size: only the k retrieved chunks enter the TPCG, so auditing a 100-chunk or a 1,000,000-chunk store costs identically. Cost moves with retrieval depth: pairwise NLI grows quadratically (42.1 ms at k=5, ≈164 ms at k=10), and AUROC varies by less than 0.01 across k ∈ [3, 10]; for k > 50, sparse Lanczos or randomized eigensolvers recover sub-100 ms latency.

text: Error Analysis. Two modes dominate the 13.6% of misclas- sified turns. (i) Implicit temporal entailment (4.8%): updates lacking explicit negation or dates (e.g., a silently revised commit hash) defeat the NLI detector and the timestamp heuristic—most often C2 read as C0. (ii) Segmentation failures (3.1%): compound clauses merge assertions into one claim node, diluting the C1 bottleneck. Remedies: temporal embed- dings and claim-decomposition tuning.

text: Oracle-free replication pilot. To verify that the pipeline needs no ground-truth labels at inference, we built a fully exe- cutable stack: a deterministic 1,200-trajectory pilot benchmark (template-disjoint splits), MiniLM embeddings, a DeBERTa-v3 NLI cross-encoder, and TPCG construction driven solely by model scores. On 32,562 turns, the learned pipeline at- tains contamination AUROC 0.871 and hallucination AUROC 1.000, with 4-class macro F1 0.810; the raw SRCA threshold reaches 0.921 and the NLI-only baseline 0.889. Fig. 2 is plotted directly from these measured scores; the gap to the headline numbers reflects the pilot’s simpler templates, while the decisive observation is that no oracle information is required for the signal to emerge. The complete stack ships with the released harness.

text: Prospective validity of λ2 (RQ2). The longitudinal evidence establishes association between spectral connectivity and sta- bility, and the ablation establishes the spectral feature’s causal contribution to detection—but not yet that λ2 at turn t predicts failures at t+∆. We therefore define a prospective protocol (windowed mean λ2 preceding failure onsets, via survival analysis over purification events) in the released harness; until it is reported, RQ2 should be read as operational anticipation, not certified forecasting.

text: F. Case Study: Clinical Diagnostic Trace

At t=1 the agent stores allergy chunk m1 (“Anaphylaxis to Cephalosporins; safe alternative: Ciprofloxacin”); at t=18 an updated guideline m18 arrives (“isolate is fluoroquinolone-resistant; switch to IV Aztreonam”). At t=24, an unmon- itored agent retrieves m1 and recommends Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO BID. RECONTRACE detects the contradiction (Pcontr=0.74, cos=0.81, Wm1,m18=0.21), driving λ2=0.082 and SRCA=0.31 ≪ θ∗=0.62; the classifier assigns C2 (P=0.89), m1 is soft-invalidated, and the agent outputs IV Aztreonam.
